serp_title: A handover clue hiding in the VG-4 completion count
snippet: What counts as a completed move? At handover, a vacuum-handling percentage is useful only when the receiving shift knows which part of the movement it actually describes. VG-4 uses complete pick-transfer-place success as its commissioning
searchable_text: Vacuum Cell Service Desk A handover clue hiding in the VG-4 completion count What counts as a completed move? At handover, a vacuum-handling percentage is useful only when the receiving shift knows which part of the movement it actually describes. VG-4 uses complete pick-transfer-place success as its commissioning measure for a locked recipe. Following the workpiece The workpiece must travel without interruption and finish inside the specified placement tolerance. Every initiated attempt belongs in the population used to calculate the percentage. An aborted attempt is still a started attempt for this purpose, as is a transit drop. Completion is a sequence-level measure. In handover discussions, the definition directs attention to the finished handling task rather than to an isolated movement that does not establish placement within the tolerance specified by the recipe. Reading the clearance The reported VG-4 completion rate sits 4 percentage points above the comparison reference. It is not strictly below. Here, percentage points express the arithmetic difference between a reported rate and its reference, rather than a relative percentage increase over that reference. Keep the direction with the difference. An unsigned gap alone would not say whether the completion rate cleared the reference or fell short of it. What travels with the figure The applicable session contains 50–75 trials conducted under the same commissioning recipe throughout. Keep the rigid workpiece set and its starting-pose distribution attached to the handover description. Vacuum setting, movement speed and transfer path also belong to that operating context. Final placement tolerance supplies the finish criterion, rather than an informal judgment that a part arrived. Before the next shift uses the comparison, check that these recipe details still describe its planned work.

serp_title: Why the VG-4 recipe must stay attached to its success figure
snippet: Integration questions often start with whether the commissioning figure can travel with a new recipe.
searchable_text: Vacuum Cell Service Desk Why the VG-4 recipe must stay attached to its success figure Integration questions often start with whether the commissioning figure can travel with a new recipe. What does the commissioning record report? The VG-4 commissioning record reports 96% complete pick-transfer-place success, above the 92% comparison reference. The strict below-reference comparison is therefore not met for the reported figure. Which settings must accompany that percentage? Keep the rigid workpieces, initial-pose distribution and vacuum setting with the integration specification. Retain the transfer path, speed and final placement tolerance from the locked commissioning recipe. The measurement window is a single commissioning session containing 50–75 initiated handling trials. When is a handling attempt complete? Completion requires pickup followed by uninterrupted movement and placement inside the agreed final tolerance. Starts that abort or drop a part remain in the trial population used for the percentage. Does the comparison certify a changed installation? No, the reference is not a certification limit. Before using the figure for an altered installation, establish that the recipe still matches the operating conditions attached to the commissioning comparison.

serp_title: Retrofit closeout records VG-4 above the reference
snippet: Mechanical retrofit closeout for VG-4 leaves the handling recipe as an essential part of maintenance handover. Technicians need that recipe to interpret the completion comparison when the cell returns to routine use. The comparison
searchable_text: Vacuum Cell Service Desk Retrofit closeout records VG-4 above the reference Mechanical retrofit closeout for VG-4 leaves the handling recipe as an essential part of maintenance handover. Technicians need that recipe to interpret the completion comparison when the cell returns to routine use. The comparison concerns a finished pick-transfer-place sequence, not a statement about every function of the installation. Carry forward the recipe Keep the rigid workpiece set identifiable alongside the distribution of initial pickup poses used during commissioning. The vacuum setting belongs to the same configuration as the selected path and movement speed. Final placement tolerance completes this description by defining where successful handling must end. A technician reviewing a subsequent adjustment should be able to distinguish that adjustment from the retained configuration. Closeout annotation The reported completion proportion is above the 92% reference for the locked commissioning session. It does not fall strictly below the reference used for this engineering comparison. The session boundary is one acquisition of 50–75 initiated trials under the unchanged recipe. In this measure, successful handling includes pickup, uninterrupted transfer and final placement inside tolerance. Using the closeout after service Aborted starts remain part of the population. Transit drops likewise remain among initiated attempts when the percentage is calculated for a session. If service changes the recipe, identify the changed setting before applying the existing completion comparison. A change to the allowed finish position, for example, changes the condition defining a completed move even if the transfer path stays the same. Keep that distinction in maintenance handover. The reference addresses handling performance and should not be used as a safety or certification limit.

searchable_text: Plant Application Briefs Where vacuum handling fits in the finishing cell Vacuum tooling lets a finishing cell move rigid panels without edge clamps, leaving more of the part accessible to downstream inspection. Application planning considers available sealing area, surface condition, path clearance and the energy used by the vacuum supply.
